devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Devices report over MQTT. The service subscribes to their topics and stores each property value as it arrives.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.hint: Each camera is an RTSP source. The media server re-publishes it so the browser can play it and the analyser can read it — both from the same path.
cameras.rtspHint: The camera's own stream address. Latin characters only.
cameras.nameHint: Shown in the interface. Any language.
cameras.streamNotReady: The stream is starting — the media server dials the camera on the first request.
cameras.starting: Starting the stream — the first play can take around 20 seconds while the camera connection is opened on demand.

detections.title: Detections
detections.hint: A worker samples one frame at a time and runs it through the models the task was started with. A camera reports only the classes those models know.
detections.modelHint: Which weights to run. A camera detects only what its models were trained on — pick more than one to cover more classes.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.hint: A detection is a fact. An alert is a judgement about it — the rules below decide which detections are worth telling someone about.
alerts.ruleNameHint: Shown on every alert this rule raises. Any language.
alerts.labelHint: Must match a model's class name exactly, in English.
alerts.labelExamples: for example: cow, truck, fire, person
alerts.minConfidenceHint: Ignore detections the model was less sure about than this.
alerts.minCountHint: How many must appear in one frame before this counts.
alerts.cooldownHint: After firing, stay quiet this long. Without it one cow raises an alert every frame.
alerts.noRules: No rules yet — add one above.
alerts.deleteRule: Delete this rule? Alerts it already raised are kept.

ask.title: Ask
ask.hint: This is not a chatbot with the database in its prompt. It is an LLM given a fixed set of functions it may call.
ask.explain: When you ask something, the model replies with a tool call — the server runs that function, which is an ordinary database query, and hands back the rows. Only then does it write a sentence. So it can never invent a number.
ask.limits: It cannot see the camera images, and it cannot answer anything the system does not store. It does know which cameras are being analysed and with which models, so it can explain an absence — whether a camera is idle, or simply running weights that have no class for what you asked about.
ask.placeholder: Ask about cameras, detections, alerts or devices
ask.unavailable: The model endpoint is not reachable.
